chunks.l2:
[tal-a21-v01] Now the initiation-rite of the one situated in absence is described.

[tal-a21-v10] Or by itself, by the force of compassion arisen towards that person even, (of one) who is the bearer of a portion of śaktipāta come towards him known.

[tal-a21-v02] For accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation one is led to the true guru: in this Mālinī sentence 'prati' is expressive of facing-towards.

[tal-a21-v03] Facing-towards of the disciple consists in becoming the seat of his grace; the saying 'worshipping him' is an indicator of the cause of grace.

[tal-a21-v04] From that connection then someone is liberated instantly: thus is also the meaning of this jewel of the Mālinī sentence.

[tal-a21-v05] 'In that instant' means there is no further moment of desire to approach; but exactly thus the guru, struck by compassion, should uplift him.

[tal-a21-v06] Of one who, body wasted by guru-service, died without obtaining initiation — or whose desire arose at the moment of death.

[tal-a21-v07] Or of one who shared the initiation-rites of lower tantras etc., having obtained samaya-status, (but) not having obtained the supreme initiation.

[tal-a21-v08] Of one struck by a ḍimba, or devoured by a yogeśī through sorcery, or slain by yantra-tantra etc. by the guru — the dead.

[tal-a21-v09] Of one who, having obtained initiation, violated his samaya — even so, through the vehement entreaty of relatives, wife, friends, sons.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-:C21 atha śrītantrāloke ekaviṃśatitamamāhnikam parokṣasaṃsthitasyātha dīkṣākarma nigadyate bhuktimuktiprasiddhyarthaṃ nīyate sadguruṃ prati / ityasminmālinīvākye pratiḥ sāṃmukhyāvācakaḥ sāṃmukhyaṃ cāsya śiṣyasya tatkṛpāspadatātmakam / tamārādhyeti vacanaṃ kṛpāhetūpalakṣaṇam tatsaṃbandhāttataḥ kaścittatkṣaṇādapavṛjyate / ityasyāyamapi hyartho mālinīvākyasanmaṇeḥ tatkṣaṇāditi nāsyāsti yiyāsādikṣaṇāntaram / kiṃtvevameva karuṇānighnastaṃ gururuddharet gurusevākṣīṇatanordīkṣāmaprāpya pañcatām / gatasyātha svayaṃ mṛtyukṣaṇoditatathāruceḥ athavādharatantrādidīkṣāsaṃskārabhāginaḥ / prāptasāmayikasyātha parāṃ dīkṣāmavindataḥ ḍimbāhatasya yogeśībhakṣitasyābhicārataḥ / mṛtasya guruṇā yantratantrādinihatasya vā bhraṣṭasvasamayasyātha dīkṣāṃ prāptavato@pyalam / bandhubhāryāsuhṛtputragāḍhābhyarthanayogataḥ svayaṃ tadviṣayotpannakaruṇābalato@pi vā / vijñātatanmukhāyātaśaktipātāṃśadharmaṇaḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a21-v11] The guru should perform the initiation redeeming the dead, bestowing Śiva; that is said by the Supreme Lord in Śrī-Mṛtyuñjaya-Siddha and the rest.

[tal-a21-v12] For the uninitiated, king and the rest, the lazy, the fallen, the dead, child, sick, woman, old — and one should arrange the redemption of the dead.

[tal-a21-v13] The rite all previously told: that is desired to be concise, devoid of guru-and-other worship, in the external for enjoyment, because it.

[tal-a21-v14] Preliminary consecration, caru, field, bed, maṇḍala-preparation are not useful here; (they are) for the disciple's purification and dream-seeing.

[tal-a21-v15] But the maṇḍala is for making mantras present and satisfied; and on the following day the worship of gods is not directly helpful for this.

[tal-a21-v16] Through rite, instrument, place, maṇḍala, form, mantra; through meditation, union, sole devotion, knowledge, identification — (these are the causes of presence).

[tal-a21-v17] Of one who entered into that, of disciples and of the guru also: these eleven are told as causes for presence.

[tal-a21-v18] Higher and higher superior, also from freedom from mixture: the rite abundantly, flowers and the rest, superior, endowed with marks.

[tal-a21-v19] Single liṅga and the rest as place, where the self is pleased; the maṇḍala three-trident-lotus-wheel, which in mantra-maṇḍala.

[tal-a21-v20] Even when not invoked, seen — the accomplishment of samaya-status of the good; that is said in the Mālinī-tantra: accomplished samaya-maṇḍala.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-gururdīkṣāṃ mṛtoddhārīṃ kurvīta śivadāyinīm / śrīmṛtyuñjayasiddhādau taduktaṃ parameśinā adīkṣite nṛpatyādāvalase patite mṛte / bālāturastrīvṛddhe ca mṛtoddhāraṃ prakalpayet vidhiḥ sarvaḥ pūrvamuktaḥ sa tu saṃkṣipta iṣyate / gurvādipūjārahito bāhye bhogāya sā yataḥ adhivāsacarukṣetraṃ śayyāmaṇḍalakalpane / nopayogyatra tacchiṣyasaṃskriyāsvapnadṛṣṭaye mantrasaṃnidhisaṃtṛptiyogāyātra tu maṇḍalam / bhūyodine ca devārcā sākṣānnāsyopakāri tat kriyopakaraṇasthānamaṇḍalākṛtimantrataḥ / dhyānayogaikatadbhaktijñānatanmayabhāvataḥ tatpraviṣṭasya kasyāpi śiṣyāṇāṃ ca gurostathā / ekādaśaite kathitāḥ saṃnidhānāya hetavaḥ uttarottaramutkṛṣṭāstathā vyāmiśraṇāvaśāt / kriyātibhūyasī puṣpādyuttamaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam ekaliṅgādi ca sthānaṃ yatrātmā saṃprasīdati / maṇḍalaṃ tritriśūlābjacakraṃ yanmantramaṇḍale anāhūte@pi dṛṣṭaṃ satsamayitvaprasādhanam / taduktaṃ mālinītantre siddhaṃ samayamaṇḍalam

chunks.l2:
[tal-a21-v21] By which, as soon as seen — thus, from the two words 'siddha' and 'mātra': the form radiant in form, which, mantra like it very radiant.

[tal-a21-v22] The rest is clearly therefore not told here in detail again; having made the maṇḍala, having worshipped the god there with kuśa grass — and.

[tal-a21-v23] With cow-dung he should make the form, disciple-like, should place; then in it one path to be purified, from the contemplation of pervasion.

[tal-a21-v24] Having deposited up to prakṛti, again he should perform the rite by the great-net-practice, from the middle of all the paths.

[tal-a21-v25] Having drawn the mind situated there — should do: that rite is said. Having risen from the mūlādhāra, the rod of the path of the vast spread endless nāḍī, having occupied by vigor, reached the nose-sky, throwing, desires to pervade up to the wheel of the path with a net of smoke-beautiful dense tips, covering — bringing the desired life — thus: the practice called the great net.

[tal-a21-v26] By this to-be-covered goes dependence on another; facing-towards-ness at first; is led to five, if all — then from the middle of the path as desired, in drawing and extracting, or in the matter of the dead person to be drawn — then in the living, yoga called the net, taught in the Śrī-Śaṃbhunātha-āgama, spoken by me.

[tal-a21-v27] When long broken apart, as two armies joined: again horse, elephant, man run towards their own caste by taste; by the nāḍī-wheels with the instrument-winds just so, joined, each with its own taste unified, by their own net subjugated.

[tal-a21-v28] Drawn by the great net, the living soul, by the knowing one, releases heaven, ghost, animal, hell — then at that time this one.

[tal-a21-v29] Obtained by that knowledge-mantra-yoga, this person also, artificial, like a yogī, then from the heart of the sādhya abandons identification.

[tal-a21-v30] The states from immobile etc., wondrous, nearness to that world — should abandon, thus: not wonder; he thus who, by action even, or.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-yena saṃdṛṣṭamātreti siddhamātrapadadvayāt / ākṛtirdīptarūpā yā mantrastadvatsudīptikaḥ śiṣṭaṃ spaṣṭamato neha kathitaṃ vistarātpunaḥ / kṛtvā maṇḍalamabhyarcya tatra devaṃ kuśairatha gomayenākṛtiṃ kuryācchiṣyavattāṃ nidhāpayet / tatastasyāṃ śodhyamekamadhvānaṃ vyāptibhāvanāt prakṛtyantaṃ vinikṣipya punarenaṃ vidhiṃ caret / mahājālaprayogeṇa sarvasmādadhvamadhyataḥ cittamākṛṣya tatrasthaṃ kuryāttadvidhirucyate / mūlādhārādudetya prasṛtasuvitatānantanāḍyadhvadaṇḍaṃ vīryeṇākramya nāsāgaganaparigataṃ vikṣipan vyāptumīṣṭe / yāvaddhūmābhirāmapracitataraśikhājālakenādhvacakraṃ saṃchādyābhīṣṭajīvānayanamiti mahājālanāmā prayogaḥ etenācchādanīyaṃ vrajati paravaśaṃ saṃmukhīnatvamādau pañcādānīyate cetsakalamatha tato@pyadhvamadhyādyatheṣṭam / ākṛṣṭāvuddhṛtau vā mṛtajanaviṣaye karṣaṇīye@tha jīve yogaḥ śrīśaṃbhunāthāgamaparigamito jālanāmā mayoktaḥ ciravighaṭite senāyugmeyathāmilite punarhayagajanaraṃ svāṃ svāṃ jātiṃ rasādabhidhāvati / karaṇapavanairnāḍīcakraistathaiva samāgatairnijanijarasādekībhāvyaṃ svajālavaśīkṛtaiḥ mahājālasamākṛṣṭo jīvo vijñānaśālinā / svaḥpretatiryaṅnirayāṃstadaivaiṣa vimuñcati tajjñānamantrayogāptaḥ puruṣaścaiṣa kṛtrimam / yogīva sādhyahṛdayāttadā tādātmyamujjhati sthāvarādidaśāścitrāstatsalokasamīpatāḥ / tyajecceti na citraṃ sa evaṃ yaḥ karmaṇāpi vā

chunks.l2:
[tal-a21-v31] From being in an eligible body, in humanity — but bodied, not then liberated; from body, at end of body, but should go to Śiva.

[tal-a21-v32] In that body but some of his arises: supreme Śāṅkara grace, from root and from knowledge or from served teacher.

[tal-a21-v33] Situated in that body, even this living soul, by net-force etc. this, pervades the body of darbha and the rest, by own abiding even unconscious.

[tal-a21-v34] By the force of abundant yoga-mantra-rite-knowledge again, even the human body this one then immediately releases.

[tal-a21-v35] Even sleeping-like, even bodiless, who is living soul: he even, drawn from the net, comes to the darbha body, of fruit, and or.

[tal-a21-v36] Jasmine fruit and the rest, whatever by that, or body-fashioning: by suitability both inside and outside, that here superior is said.

[tal-a21-v37] Then the living soul brought by the net method stands as if asleep, from absence of obtaining apparatus of mind-endowed body and the rest.

[tal-a21-v38] It neither vibrates nor knows nor speaks nor certainly desires; for such a one indeed, all purificatory rites as before should prepare.

[tal-a21-v39] By seedless initiation yoga, all having done the previously-told rite producing union, with full oblation together, should throw and him.

[tal-a21-v40] In the body of darbha and the rest, offered into the fire of mantra together with full, freed from bonds goes to Śiva, free from return again.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-adhikāriśarīratvānmānuṣye tu śarīragaḥ / na tadā mucyate dehāddehānte tu śivaṃ vrajet tasmindehe tu kāpyasya jāyate śāṅkarī parā / bhaktirūhācca vijñānādācāryādvāpyasevitāt taddehasaṃsthito@pyeṣa jīvo jālabalādimam / dārbhādidehaṃ vyāpnoti svādhiṣṭhityāpyacetayan yogamantrakriyājñānabhūyobalavaśātpunaḥ / manuṣyadehamapyeṣa tadaivāśu vimuñcati suptakalpo@pyadeho@pi yo jīvaḥ so@pi jālataḥ / ākṛṣṭo dārbhamāyāti dehaṃ phalamayaṃ ca vā jātīphalādi yatkiṃcittena vā dehakalpanā / antarbahirdvayaucityāttadatrotkṛṣṭamucyate tato jālakramānītaḥ sa jīvaḥ suptavatsthitaḥ / manoviśiṣṭadehādisāmagrīprāptyabhāvataḥ na spandate na jānāti na vakti na kilecchati / tādṛśasyaiva saṃskārān sarvān prāgvatprakalpayet nirbījadīkṣāyogena sarvaṃ kṛtvā puroditam / vidhiṃ yojanikāṃ pūrṇāhutyā sākaṃ kṣipecca tam dārbhādidehe mantrāgnāvarpite pūrṇayā saha / muktapāśaḥ śivaṃ yāti punarāvṛttivarjitaḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a21-v41] Furnished with proof but this, where the darbha-born body vibrates: there, by the yoga of offering prāṇa, mind, mantra, so may happen.

[tal-a21-v42] Of the one with practice that also is said (breathing force); not for that, by the same means as redemption of the dead, as possible, by means.

[tal-a21-v43] Initiation of living absent also to be performed, seedless but it: in it, in fashioning form resembling darbha, from net-yoga.

[tal-a21-v44] Drawing by imagination alone of the living soul, from fear of death: the rest as before, without burning kuśa and the rest form.

[tal-a21-v45] From limitedness and non-lordship in the sādhya, from niyati-constraint, net-drawing without practice, from attachment and aversion not, arises.

[tal-a21-v46] Absent: indeed by unequal initiations if initiated, there superior may be mighty; for purification but the inferior.

[tal-a21-v47] In the union for enjoyment but, by many gurus so, when performed, variety of enjoyment from variety of causes.

[tal-a21-v48] In initiation of absent, beyond māyā, for enjoyment should join; desire for enjoyment rare indeed being, or for cessation of enjoyment.

[tal-a21-v49] Said indeed: of own and other consciousness, own consciousness more powerful in overriding; that which overrides, of equality and indifference so.

[tal-a21-v50] Venerable Dharmaśiva said: in absence, in the karma procedure, in initiation of absent, properly, in the full oblation rite, if.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-sapratyayā tviyaṃ yatra spandate darbhajā tanuḥ / tatra prāṇamanomantrārpaṇayogāttathā bhavet sābhyāsasya tadapyuktaṃ balāśvāsi na tatkṛte / mṛtoddhāroditaireva yathāsaṃbhūti hetubhiḥ jīvatparokṣadīkṣāpi kāryā nirbījikā tu sā / tasyāṃ darbhākṛtiprāyakalpane jālayogataḥ saṃkalpamātreṇākarṣo jīvasya mṛtibhītitaḥ / śiṣṭaṃ prāgvatkuśādyutthākāraviploṣavarjitam pārimityādanaiśvaryātsādhye niyatiyantraṇāt / jālākṛṣṭirvinābhyāsaṃ rāgadveṣānna jāyate parokṣa evātulyābhirdīkṣābhiryadi dīkṣitaḥ / tatrottaraṃ syādbalavatsaṃskārāya tvadhastanam bhuktiyojanikāyāṃ tu bhūyobhirgurubhistathā / kṛtāyāṃ bhogavaicitryaṃ hetuvaicitryayogataḥ parokṣadīkṣaṇe māyottīrṇe bhogāya yojayet / bhogānīpsā durlabhā hi satī vā bhogahānaye uktaṃ hi svānyasaṃvittyoḥ svasaṃvidbalavattarā / bādhakatve bādhikāsau sāmyaudāsīnyayostathā śrīmān dharmaśivo@pyāha pārokṣyāṃ karmapaddhatau / parokṣadīkṣaṇe samyak pūrṇāhutividhau yadi

chunks.l2:
[tal-a21-v51] Fire emits ciṭi-ciṭā sound with smoke, bears blue-cloud-color, repeatedly blazes, subsides.

[tal-a21-v52] Detail, terrible form and, runs on earth and downwards; or crow-etc unheard sound: then him the guru should mark.

[tal-a21-v53] By brahmin-killing and the rest, by sins and by association with them minor sins: then of him not to be done, initiation in this unperformed rite.

[tal-a21-v54] Nine-souled, standing inside the phaṭ cavity, again endowed with five phaṭs: of so-and-so thus, sins, I burn according to eight phaṭs.

[tal-a21-v55] Thus thousand-fold fire-offering to be done with sesame and rice; at the end full and to be given; then to him by initiation the guru.

[tal-a21-v56] Up to the supreme goal should do purification of principles; even in direct presence of the paśu situated, of the sinner, Bhagavan-filled.

[tal-a21-v57] Power of the one who obtained: the eldest, exactly thus rite should perform; if or the teacher properly not blazing of him before that.

[tal-a21-v58] By expiations so, by gifts, by breath-controls and, purification having done, this rite and also initiation should perform without doubt.

[tal-a21-v59] In every way being even, the tattva-knower liberates beasts by will alone; Śiva directly — therefore him should worship always.

[tal-a21-v60] Deceit there not to be done; and having done that downwards should go the disciple. Not again should proclaim of him sin; the proclaimer should go.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-agniściṭiciṭāśabdaṃ sadhūmaṃ pratimuñcati / dhatte nīlāmbudacchāyāṃ muhurjvalati śāmyati vistaro ghorarūpaśca mahīṃ dhāvati cāpyadhaḥ / dhvāṃkṣādyaśravyaśabdo vā tadā taṃ lakṣayedguruḥ brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpaistatsaṅgaiścopapātakaiḥ / tadā tasya na kartavyā dīkṣāsminnakṛte vidhau navātmā phaṭpuṭāntaḥsthaḥ punaḥ pañcaphaḍanvitaḥ / amukasyeti pāpāni dahāmyanu phaḍaṣṭakam iti sāhasriko homaḥ kartavyastilataṇḍulaiḥ / ante pūrṇā ca dātavyā tato@smai dīkṣayā guruḥ parayojanaparyantaṃ kuryāttattvaviśodhanam / pratyakṣe@pi sthitasyāṇoḥ pāpino bhagavanmayīm śaktiṃ prāptavato jyeṣṭhāmevameva vidhiṃ caret / yadi vā daiśikaḥ samyaṅ na dīptastasya tatpurā prāyaścittaistathā dānaiḥ prāṇāyāmaiśca śodhanam / kṛtvā vidhimimāṃ cāpi dīkṣāṃ kuryādaśaṅkitaḥ sarvathā vartamāno@pi tattvavinmocayetpaśūn / icchayaiva śivaḥ sākṣāttasmāttaṃ pūjayetsadā śāṭhyaṃ tatra na kāryaṃ ca tatkṛtvādho vrajecchiśuḥ / na punaḥ kīrtayettasya pāpaṃ kīrtayitā vrajet

chunks.l2: [tal-a21-v61] Hell should avoid — therefore thus in Dīkṣottara rite. This initiation of absent twofold told, by division of living and other.
